newHere.title: New here?
newHere.hook: Our search engine is really powerful, but might feel overwhelming. To help you get started, you can do one of the following:
newHere.1: Just use the search without filters. This will default to searching by card names.
newHere.2: Use the <1>TCG specific search builder</1> and construct your query without having to type anything.
newHere.3: Try to use the most basic filters first. Such as <1>name:</1> or <3>text:</3> and build your way from there. For a list of filters, you can click <5>here</5>.
newHere.footer: For questions and anything else, feel free to contact us via <1>email</1> or on our <3>Discord</3>.
